displayName: Solara: errors in Functions or scheduled jobs

documentation.content: An ERROR was logged by a Solara Cloud Function or Cloud Scheduler job: a failed request or webhook, a failed maintenance task, a stalled or given-up account deletion, the cost guard engaging, or billing detached. Open the log entry, then follow docs/RUNBOOK.md (Alerts).

conditions.displayName: ERROR log from Functions or Cloud Scheduler

conditionMatchedLog.filter: severity>=ERROR AND (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" OR resource.type="cloud_function" OR resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job")
